title: Missing moeb tool: Read (oversized README JSON)
description: Used Claude Code Read tool to read the harness-persisted JSON output from read_file on .moeb/README.md (54KB+) after the inline result was truncated. No moeb tool for reading these harness JSON artifacts.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb equivalent for reading large harness-persisted JSON output files, or extend read_file with a paginated/range mode to avoid inline truncation.
